title: 2.3.22 Fix the Type Mismatch
description: This code should print Second place and prints No medal instead. Fix it without changing the case values. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Explain why it fails
steps.instructions: Run the code and confirm it prints No medal. place is the string '2', and the cases are the numbers 1 and 2: strict equality means neither case can match.

steps.title: Fix it without changing the case values
steps.instructions: The case values must stay exactly as they are. Fix the bug by converting the switched value itself so it becomes a number before any case is checked.
